## Motivation

With `tool_choice="auto"` and non-strict tools no grammar covers the turn, and `parallel_tool_calls=False` was not applied to the parsed result either. `maxItems: 1` is only attached for `tool_choice="required"` / a named function, so on the auto path the flag had no effect: the model generates freely and the response carries every call it emitted.

Reproduced on Qwen3.8-27B (`--tool-call-parser qwen3_coder`): `What's the weather in Hanoi and Tokyo? Use the tool.` with one `get_weather` tool, `tool_choice="auto"`, `parallel_tool_calls=false` returns 2 tool calls (Hanoi, Tokyo), in both non-stream and stream modes. OpenAI semantics say at most one.

An earlier attempt exists in #37157, which takes the same approach but no longer applies to `main` (`FunctionCallParser` gained `prefix`/`constrained`/`tool_choice`, `serving_chat`/`serving_responses` changed) and has no review yet; this PR re-does it on current `main` and adds the `/v1/responses` paths and tests. #43112 (Anthropic `disable_parallel_tool_use`) is a different endpoint and is not touched.

## Modifications

- `FunctionCallParser(parallel_tool_calls=True)`: non-stream (`parse_non_stream`) keeps only the first parsed call; streaming (`parse_stream_chunk`, `parse_stream_end`) locks onto the first call's `tool_index` and drops items of later calls (`_keep_first_call`).
- Pass `request.parallel_tool_calls` into the parser in chat (non-stream, stream, and the `required` probe path) and in `/v1/responses` (non-stream and stream; `parallel_tool_calls is not False`, the field is Optional there).
- Default `True`, so `parallel_tool_calls` true/unset behaves as before; `required` / named choices already carry `maxItems: 1` and are unaffected.
- Not done here: the model still generates the extra calls and they are dropped afterwards. Stopping generation after the first call would save the tokens and is left for a follow-up.
- Tests: `TestParallelToolCallsFalse` (4 cases, real `qwen25` detector, stream fed in 7-char chunks) in `test_function_call_parser.py`, and one case in `test_serving_chat.py` checking the flag reaches the parser on both paths. 3 of the 4 parser cases and the serving case fail without the change.

## Accuracy Tests

No forward or kernel change. Live check, Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 + EAGLE, `--tool-call-parser qwen3_coder`, 1×RTX PRO 6000, release/v0.5.23 image with the patch overlaid (this branch is rebased on current `main`, covered by the unit tests only). Two-city prompt above:

| `parallel_tool_calls` | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `false`, non-stream | 2 calls | 1 call (Hanoi) |
| `false`, stream | 2 calls | 1 call (Hanoi) |
| `true` / unset | 2 calls | 2 calls |

Also run against a production deployment (1×H200, Qwen3.8-27B-FP8, `--attention-backend fa3`, EAGLE, HiCache, 1M context, `--reasoning-parser qwen3 --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder`, release/v0.5.23 with this patch mounted): same results as the table, including the streaming cases.

Known limit: the streaming clamp keys on `tool_index`. Detectors that report an index by tool position rather than call order (`gemma4`) or always 0 (`gigachat3`) cannot be separated this way; the other detectors checked report call order.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

None expected: a slice/filter over the already-parsed calls.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). (`ruff` with the repo's selected rules and `ruff format` clean; the full pre-commit hook set was not run locally.)
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

         constrained: bool = False,
+        parallel_tool_calls: bool = True,
     ):
         self.tools = tools
         self.tool_strict_level = envs.SGLANG_TOOL_STRICT_LEVEL.get()
+        # Grammar constraints cap a turn at one call only for required/named
+        # tool_choice and strict tools; plain auto output is unconstrained, so
+        # parallel_tool_calls=False is also enforced on the parsed result.
+        self.parallel_tool_calls = parallel_tool_calls
+        self._single_call_index: Optional[int] = None
         detector_class = self.ToolCallParserEnum.get(tool_call_parser)
         if detector_class:
             kwargs = {}
@@ -216,6 +222,8 @@ def parse_non_stream(
         has_tool_call = self.detector.has_tool_call(full_text)
         parsed_result = self.detector.detect_and_parse(full_text, self.tools)
         tool_call_list = parsed_result.calls
+        if not self.parallel_tool_calls:
+            tool_call_list = tool_call_list[:1]
         if tool_call_list or has_tool_call:
             return parsed_result.normal_text, tool_call_list
         else:
@@ -245,7 +253,15 @@ def parse_stream_chunk(self, chunk_text: str) -> Tuple[str, list[ToolCallItem]]:
             final_calls.extend(sp_result.calls)
             final_normal_text = sp_result.normal_text
 
-        return final_normal_text, final_calls
+        return final_normal_text, self._keep_first_call(final_calls)
+
+    def _keep_first_call(self, calls: list[ToolCallItem]) -> list[ToolCallItem]:
+        """Streaming items of one call share a tool_index; keep only the first."""
+        if self.parallel_tool_calls or not calls:
+            return calls
+        if self._single_call_index is None:
+            self._single_call_index = calls[0].tool_index
+        return [c for c in calls if c.tool_index == self._single_call_index]

@@ -256,7 +272,7 @@ def parse_stream_end(self) -> Tuple[str, list[ToolCallItem]]:

             return "", []
         sp_result = self.detector.finish(self.tools)
-        return sp_result.normal_text, sp_result.calls

     def get_legacy_structural_tag(

             tool_calls = payload["choices"][0]["delta"]["tool_calls"]

+    def test_parallel_tool_calls_false_reaches_tool_call_parser(self):
+        """parallel_tool_calls=False must reach the FunctionCallParser built for
+        auto tool choice, else a second tool call in the same turn is returned."""
+        self.chat.tool_call_parser = "hermes"
+        tools = [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "get_weather"}}]
+        req = ChatCompletionRequest(
+            model="x",
+            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "weather in Hanoi and Tokyo?"}],
+            tools=tools,
+            parallel_tool_calls=False,
+            stream=True,
+        )
+        with patch(
+            "sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.serving_chat.FunctionCallParser"
+        ) as ParserMock:
+            ParserMock.return_value.has_tool_call.return_value = False
+            self.chat._process_tool_calls(
+                text="hi",
+                tools=tools,
+                finish_reason={"type": "stop", "matched": None},
+                parallel_tool_calls=False,
+            )
+            self.assertIs(ParserMock.call_args.kwargs["parallel_tool_calls"], False)
+
+            ParserMock.return_value.parse_stream_chunk.return_value = ("", [])
+
+            async def drain():
+                async for _ in self.chat._process_tool_call_stream(
+                    index=0,
+                    delta="x",
+                    parser_dict={},
+                    content={"meta_info": {"id": "chatcmpl-test"}},
+                    request=req,
+                    has_tool_calls={},
+                    created=0,
+                ):
+                    pass
+
+            get_or_create_event_loop().run_until_complete(drain())
+            self.assertIs(ParserMock.call_args.kwargs["parallel_tool_calls"], False)
+
     def test_dpsk_v32_encoding_path(self):
         """Test DeepSeek V3.2 encoding path detection and application."""
         from sglang.srt.parser.template_manager import TemplateManager

@@ -6274,5 +6274,64 @@ def test_matches_registry(self):
         )
 
 
+class TestParallelToolCallsFalse(unittest.TestCase):
+    """parallel_tool_calls=False must cap an unconstrained (tool_choice=auto)
+    turn at one tool call, in both the non-streaming and streaming paths."""
+
+    TEXT = (
+        '<tool_call>\n{"name": "get_weather", "arguments": {"city": "Hanoi"}}\n'
+        "</tool_call>\n"
+        '<tool_call>\n{"name": "get_weather", "arguments": {"city": "Tokyo"}}\n'
+        "</tool_call>"
+    )
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.tools = [
+            Tool(
+                type="function",
+                function=Function(
+                    name="get_weather",
+                    parameters={
+                        "type": "object",
+                        "properties": {"city": {"type": "string"}},
+                        "required": ["city"],
+                    },
+                ),
+            )
+        ]
+
+    def _stream(self, parallel_tool_calls):
+        parser = FunctionCallParser(
+            self.tools, "qwen25", parallel_tool_calls=parallel_tool_calls
+        )
+        calls = []
+        for i in range(0, len(self.TEXT), 7):
+            calls += parser.parse_stream_chunk(self.TEXT[i : i + 7])[1]
+        calls += parser.parse_stream_end()[1]
+        args = {}
+        for c in calls:
+            args[c.tool_index] = args.get(c.tool_index, "") + (c.parameters or "")
+        return args
+
+    def test_non_stream_keeps_only_first_call(self):
+        parser = FunctionCallParser(self.tools, "qwen25", parallel_tool_calls=False)
+        _, calls = parser.parse_non_stream(self.TEXT)
+        self.assertEqual([json.loads(c.parameters) for c in calls], [{"city": "Hanoi"}])
+
+    def test_non_stream_default_keeps_all_calls(self):
+        parser = FunctionCallParser(self.tools, "qwen25")
+        _, calls = parser.parse_non_stream(self.TEXT)
+        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 2)
+
+    def test_stream_keeps_only_first_call(self):
+        args = self._stream(parallel_tool_calls=False)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            {k: json.loads(v) for k, v in args.items()}, {0: {"city": "Hanoi"}}
+        )
+
+    def test_stream_default_keeps_all_calls(self):
+        self.assertEqual(sorted(self._stream(parallel_tool_calls=True)), [0, 1])
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
